title: Director, Systems Analysis (Quality Engineering Capabilities)
location_text: Ohio - Columbus, Three Nationwide Plaza; Arizona - Scottsdale, 18700 North Hayden Road; United States - Remote; Iowa - Des Moines, 1100 Locust Street
description:
If you’re passionate about being part of a dynamic organization that enables a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales to drive innovation and adopt new technologies that deliver business results, then Nationwide’s Technology team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.
This role will work a hybrid schedule coming into the Columbus, Ohio, Des Moines, Iowa or Scottsdale, Arizona office 2 days per week on Tuesdays & Thursdays. Remote internal associates may also be considered.
Defines and drives Nationwide’s enterprise strategy for quality engineering and requirements analysis, establishing the standards, operating patterns, governance, and enablement needed to improve software quality while accelerating safe delivery.
Sets the strategic direction for AI-enabled testing and analysis capabilities that increase automation, strengthen requirements-to-test traceability, and improve delivery confidence across the software development lifecycle.
Advances modern, scalable approaches to test automation, intelligent test design, self-service test data, and requirements analysis practices that enable faster feedback, stronger controls, and greater engineering productivity.
Establishes the quality engineering and requirements analysis practices needed to support more frequent release cycles, enabling delivery teams to progress toward weekly and daily deployments while maintaining appropriate levels of security, quality, resilience, and risk control.
Applies a strong software engineering mindset and credible software engineering background to translate enterprise strategy into measurable adoption, delivery, quality, and productivity outcomes.
Builds repeatable practices for AI-ready engineering and supports the evolution toward semi-autonomous and autonomous delivery models, ensuring quality, security, and requirements practices are embedded earlier in the delivery lifecycle.
Defines and tracks enterprise measures of adoption, effectiveness, quality, delivery velocity, and business value to demonstrate the impact of quality engineering, requirements analysis, automation, and AI-enabled delivery investments.
Leads enterprise enablement and adoption activities that help technology teams implement consistent quality engineering, requirements analysis, test automation, intelligent testing, and AI-assisted delivery practices.
Influences and collaborates with senior stakeholders across Software Engineering, Architecture, Security, and business leadership to align enterprise priorities, investment decisions, operating practices, and execution with Nationwide’s modernization and delivery objectives.
Provides enterprise leadership for the continuous improvement of quality engineering and requirements analysis capabilities, identifying opportunities to reduce delivery friction, improve feedback cycles, strengthen controls, and scale engineering excellence across products, platforms, and lines of business.

Job Description Summary
If you’re enthusiastic about delivering secure technology solutions to support a company providing extraordinary care to its customers, then Nationwide Technology is the place for you. Nationwide's industry-leading technology workforce embraces an agile work environment and a collaborative culture to deliver outstanding solutions and results. If that sounds like something you aspire to, we want to hear from you!
As a Technology Analysis Director, you will hire and coach Technology Analysis associates and ensure all products and services meet business requirements and end user needs through digital transformation, automation, quality and excellence.
Job Description
Key Responsibilities:
Responsible for the hiring, compensation and performance management of their team and the development of Technology Analysis talent by providing coaching and feedback.
Oversees quality of work delivered by Technology Analysis professionals and deals effectively with quality issues in a timely manner.

NOTE TO EMPLOYMENT AGENCIES:
We value the partnerships we have built with our preferred vendors. Nationwide does not accept unsolicited resumes from employment agencies. All resumes submitted by employment agencies directly to any Nationwide employee or hiring manager in any form without a signed Nationwide Client Services Agreement on file and search engagement for that position will be deemed unsolicited in nature. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is subsequently hired as a result of the referral or through other means.
Nationwide pays on a geographic-specific salary structure and placement within the actual starting salary range for this position will be determined by a number of factors including the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; the scope, complexity and location of the role as well as the cost of labor in the market; and other conditions of employment. If a Sales job, Sales Incentives, based on performance goals are possible in addition to this range. Note on Compensation for Part-Time Roles: Please be aware that the salary ranges listed below reflect full-time compensation. Actual compensation may be prorated based on the number of hours worked relative to a full-time schedule.

The expected starting salary range for Director, Systems Analysis : $149,000.00 - $223,000.00
